expectations.text: The response asks what decision or problem the analysis should support
expectations.evidence: “分析用途（定价决策 / 融资 BP / 功能排期 / GTM），输出的侧重点会不同” explicitly requests the purpose and decision context.

expectations.text: The response does not treat the listed dimensions as a complete task definition
expectations.evidence: “要继续的话，需要你补充” requests the product sector, target customers and region, competitor list, and analysis purpose.

expectations.text: The response does not invent competitor data
expectations.evidence: “我无法判断‘竞品’指的是哪个领域。” The response requests source materials and provides an unpopulated template without asserting competitor facts.
